I wrote the Harbor workspace settings screen to `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and fonts are unchecked.

It's a static HTML and CSS page inside `#component` at 1280px wide, following DESIGN.md. It sits on a white page, in a column up to 1120px wide. Each section has its heading on the left, in Unbounded Light caps, and a bordered card on the right. The card holds the fields, switches or danger text.

- **Tokens:** I inlined the tokens from `tokens.css` that the page uses, because the file has to be self-contained.
- **Buttons:** Save Changes is the ink primary pill. Delete Workspace is the secondary outline pill, with no red.
- **Switches:** The notification switches are styled checkboxes with `role="switch"`. The first two start on and Product updates starts off. You didn't specify defaults, so those are my choice.
- **Save Changes placement:** DESIGN.md puts the screen's primary action in the top row on the right. Your brief puts it inside the General section, so I followed the brief. The top row only has the page title.
- **Fonts:** No font files are provided, so Unbounded and Archivo will fall back to system fonts unless they're installed.

I first added an inline `onsubmit` handler by mistake. I removed it, so the file has no JavaScript.
